name: WordPress
description: World's most popular CMS/blog engine, installed from the official latest release.
install_script:
set -e
SITE="{{ www_root }}/{{ domain }}"
mkdir -p "$SITE"
cd "$SITE"
curl -sSLo /tmp/panelpro-wordpress.tar.gz https://wordpress.org/latest.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/panelpro-wordpress.tar.gz --strip-components=1
rm -f /tmp/panelpro-wordpress.tar.gz
cp wp-config-sample.php wp-config.php
sed -i "s/database_name_here/{{ db_name }}/; s/username_here/{{ db_user }}/; s/password_here/{{ db_pass }}/" wp-config.php
sed -i "s/put your unique phrase here/{{ secret }}" wp-config.php || true
if command -v chown >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  OWNER=$(id -un www-data 2>/dev/null || id -un apache 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$OWNER" ] && chown -R "$OWNER":"$OWNER" "$SITE"
fi
echo "WordPress installed at $SITE"
uninstall_script:
rm -rf "{{ www_root }}/{{ domain }}"
echo "WordPress folder removed"
